essence:
Having traced the categories from the Śivatattva down through the pure group
(V3-J), Abhinavagupta now descends into the impure realm — the world of the bound knower (paśu).
> In the distinction, though, one-flavor-manifested, with the I-ness, in the non-self, seen —

[The bound state: though the reality is one-flavor, in the distinction the I-ness (ahantā) is seen in
the non-self (anātman) — the self wrongly identified with the body and the rest.
